props.caption: Flight and newsroom alerts prompted safety responses across Europe, while investigators have not identified a common author.
Iran reported fires on two tankers and a tug in the Strait of Hormuz.
Paraguay’s Senate removed Santiago Peña and Pedro Alliana took office.

lead.what: Flight and newsroom alerts prompted safety responses across Europe, while investigators have not identified a common author.

rest.what: Iran reported fires on two tankers and a tug in the Strait of Hormuz.

lead.what: EFS said altered refrigeration settings at three plasma cold-storage sites were detected before blood products or samples were compromised.

rest.what: The October employment report showed a 165,000 payroll gain and a 4.1% unemployment rate.

lead.what: The unanimous Senate vote installs Pedro Alliana as president while criminal investigations continue.
